instruction: Can you configure Ask.com to be my browser's default search provider?

metadata.explanation: Task requires configuring Chrome to use Ask.com as the default search engine. Uses existing getter get_default_search_engine and metric match_in_list to verify the configuration. Accepts both 'Ask.com' and 'Ask' as valid names.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts default search engine name from Chrome Preferences file at the correct OS-specific path
Metric correctly checks if result matches any value in expected list ['Ask.com', 'Ask']
Expected values are semantically correct - Chrome may store either 'Ask.com' or 'Ask' as the short_name
Postconfig appropriately restarts Chrome to ensure preferences are persisted and reloaded from disk
Complete coverage - evaluator verifies the only requirement in the instruction (default search engine configuration)
Data flow is correct: getter extracts search engine name → metric checks if it's in the expected list
